newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Hohn to resign as IBM Brasil president-paper.
newsitem.headline: Hohn to resign as IBM Brasil president-paper.

text.p: Rudolph Hohn, head of International Business Machine Corp's Brazil unit for the past 10 years, will step down at the end of December, a local newspaper said.

The financial daily Gazeta Mercantil said the departure of Hohn, 56, stems from a company-wide restructuring that reduces the autonomy of IBM's units and centralises decision-making for Latin America.
The paper, which cited Hohn, said he had been with IBM for 30 years and in January had been both president of IBM Brasil and IBM's vice president of business infrastructure for Latin America.
"The functions require constant travels which family obligations prevented me from carrying out," he was quoted as saying.
He also acknowledged that his leaving stemmed from his having reached the end of a "professional cycle," Gazeta said.
